pages.title: Resist Control
pages.text: Thoughts help retain control when an ability attempts to restrict your actions. Sustained control pressure drains Thoughts; rapid repeated applications do not multiply that drain.$(br2)At an empty bar, this protection is lost and control becomes more dangerous. Deliberate exhaustion is not required to learn the lesson.

pages.title: Recover and Preserve
pages.text: Watch the Thoughts bar and escape sustained control. Restore Thoughts through recovery or suitable pills such as Spirit Nourishing.$(br2)Against several control users, preserve a reserve rather than exhausting the entire bar on the first restraint.
